title: Lunara signing keys
description: The public keys Lunara Society signs published assertions with. RFC 8037 Ed25519 JWKs. A superseded key stays in this document with `revoked` set rather than being removed: a key that disappears turns every assertion it ever signed into an unknown-key failure, which a verifier cannot tell apart from a forgery.

kid.description: Key id, derived from the key material itself so it cannot be pointed at a different key later.

x.description: The public key, base64url. There is no `d` member here and there never will be — that is the secret half.

status.description: development means the key was not generated in dedicated custody. It is published as such rather than presented as more than it is; a development key must also carry `assurance` saying what it does not establish.

revoked.description: Null while the key is live. Once set, it carries the date from which signatures under this key should be disbelieved, and the reason.
